{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read data to ensure clean state
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check for confounding: is arm assignment related to severity?
# Cross-tabulate arm vs severity
crosstab_arm_severity = pd.crosstab(df_dedup['arm'], df_dedup['severity'])
print('Cross-tabulation of arm vs severity:')
print(crosstab_arm_severity)

# Calculate response rates by arm
response_rate_treatment = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
response_rate_control = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()

# Treatment effect: difference in proportions (treatment - control)
treatment_effect = response_rate_treatment - response_rate_control

# Print results
print(f'Treatment response rate: {response_rate_treatment:.4f}')
print(f'Control response rate: {response_rate_control:.4f}')
print(f'Treatment effect (diff in proportions): {treatment_effect:.4f}')"}
